product.title: Nail Polish Nude Neutrals Soak Off Gel Polish
product.body_html:
Nude Neutral Gel Nail Polish
Elegant nude gel polish that creates a clean, sophisticated manicure. Great for everyday wear and nail art.

How to Use:
Apply thin, even layers to prepared nails and cure each layer under a UV/LED lamp as directed.

Size/Material:
Net Content: 8.5g/ml
Texture: Sticky Gel
Features: Bright Color, One-Stroke Application
